description: This file implements the CrosvmDisplayController class, which manages display configurations for crosvm virtual machine instances, including adding, removing, and listing displays, as well as executing display-related commands.

classes.name: CrosvmDisplayController
classes.description: A class responsible for managing display configurations for crosvm VM instances, including adding, removing, and listing displays.

methods.name: GetCrosvmDisplayController
methods.description: Factory function to obtain a CrosvmDisplayController instance after verifying the VM mode is kCrosvm.

methods.name: CrosvmDisplayController::Add
methods.description: Adds display configurations to a specific VM instance.

methods.name: CrosvmDisplayController::Remove
methods.description: Removes displays from a specific VM instance based on display IDs.

methods.name: CrosvmDisplayController::List
methods.description: Lists current displays for a specific VM instance.

methods.name: CrosvmDisplayController::RunCrosvmDisplayCommand
methods.description: Executes a crosvm command related to display management, handling process execution and error logging.
